summary: A verified landing releases every occupancy row of that session in any work item, and the release a session_vacate produces happens at its verified landing (CD-0190); a claim records the host process identity at creation; a row without identity releases when every live host lease started after its recorded_at and an unreadable lease set releases nothing; the adapter moves a session out of a terminal work item's worktree after a completed or cancelled transition; and worktree_audit_reclaim classifies every drift row before its limit bounds reclaim attempts.
title: A worktree occupancy row releases when no live process predates it, and the reclaim limit counts attempts
